hypothesis: Training H3 tail-2 contributes at least 0.25 percentage points more fixed-val40 action-loss improvement than training only the action input/time/state/output adapters under the identical E17 budget.
single_variable: Freeze every shared H3 block and H3 video output projection; all data, initialization seed, action adapters, objectives, noise, optimizer, steps and validation remain identical to E17.
parent_baseline: E17 shared-H3 tail-2 s100: fixed val40 action improvement 0.453% and video improvement 2.166% over the same initialization.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.local: shared H3 blocks and video output projection frozen; action adapters trainable
architecture.rationale: This deliberately isolates whether adapting pretrained H3 blocks causes the parent improvement.

data.local: the exact first 800 rows used by E17 and the same episode-disjoint val40
data.rationale: Seed, order, sample count and manifests are controlled.

action.rationale: No action-contract variable changes between arms.

objective.local: identical E17 future-video/action velocity MSE, although frozen video parameters receive no update
objective.rationale: Keeping video loss in the graph controls forward context and exposes expected zero shared-H3 gradient.

optimization.local: same seed, global batch 8, lr 1e-6, warmup 10 and 100 steps as E17
optimization.rationale: A short paired ablation is sufficient to reject or retain the tail-update mechanism before longer training.

evaluation.rationale: This experiment selects a mechanism and makes no closed-loop claim.

evidence: explicit requires_grad freeze after shared model construction
same manifests, seed and order as E17
unchanged E17 velocity targets and shifted timesteps
E16 proves action loss reaches adapters; runtime asserts positive adapter gradient and zero shared gradient is expected
the bounded run itself is the freeze-boundary canary
shared model save/restore validated independently in E16
E17 metrics and checkpoint are fixed
not required or claimed for mechanism ablation

decision.rationale: Run the strict paired ablation once. Retain H3 tail updates only if E17 beats adapter-only by at least 0.25 percentage points on fixed val40 action loss; otherwise prefer the cheaper adapter path and investigate conditioning before scaling.
